div.div: seo-agent writes drafts to the site's callback port; CronJobs only POST a kickoff. The site owns only its delegate route; the Gateway, certificate and root routing table live in the cluster repository. Traefik was removed on 9 November 2026; Kong was prepared but never became the edge.

text.tspan: seo-agent writes drafts to the site's callback port; CronJobs only POST a kickoff. The site owns only its delegate route; the Gateway, certificate and root routing table live in the cluster
